tagline: Watch faces for Wear OS, made in Bergen, Norway.

faces.name: Relief
faces.intro: A milled digital watch face for Wear OS. Large time, deep pockets for your data, and a surface you choose.
images: Relief always-on display, dimmed with frames
features: 8 complication slots: any data from any app on your watch
Built-in weather, UV index, chance of rain, today's high and low, or nothing at all in empty fields
7 accent colours and 10 surfaces: brushed, sunburst, perlage, Côtes de Genève, carbon and more
Hour colour, plate tint and rim marks
